name: Tiller
description: This allows Claude to access your transactions in your Tiller spreadsheet so that you can ask Claude questions about your spending.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tiller to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tiller to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-tools.tillermoney.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tiller MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiller provides these MCP tools: list_categories, list_spreadsheets, query_transactions, and update_transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tiller?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tiller in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Tiller requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tiller is developed by Tiller. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
